topic: Entre mamadeiras e aéreos: em novo momento, Italo Ferreira aprende a se dividir entre o surfe e a paternidade O GLOBO Brasil
insights: Italo Ferreira has started working with a full-time coach to enhance his performance in surfing.
He recently signed a deal with Nike, marking a significant partnership in his career.
Ferreira's son, Martin, is 7 months old, which has led him to adjust his priorities between surfing and fatherhood.
Despite the challenges of balancing fatherhood and a professional career, Ferreira continues to perform at a high level in surfing competitions.
The Brazilian interest in surfing remains strong, with Ferreira being a key figure in the sport.

quotes.text: Eu tive que reajustar toda a minha vida com a chegada do Martim, é um momento muito especial para a gente.

summary: Italo Ferreira is navigating the dual roles of a professional surfer and a new father, having recently signed a deal with Nike and started working with a full-time coach. His son Martin's arrival has prompted significant adjustments in his life, yet he remains committed to maintaining high performance in his surfing career.
